name: Runner Extras - Guarded Codeunit.Run Refusal
brief: Issue #5342: a guarded Codeunit.Run (`Ok := Codeunit.Run(...)`, static or on a codeunit variable) swallowed every exception into false, runner refusals and raw CLR exceptions included, and left GetLastErrorText() empty. BC's NavCodeunit.DoRunAsync catches only a NavBaseException there, so a refusal now escapes the guarded run by name, while an AL error, a BC-raised error and a CLR exception BC remaps to an AL error still come back as false with their text.
description: Runner-specific by construction: which exceptions a runner refusal is, and that it must not turn into a quiet false. The plain-BC half (a guarded run returns false and GetLastErrorText carries the inner error, both forms) is BC behaviour and lives upstream in the al-language corpus as codeunit 60217 'Test Codeunit Run Guard', which a service tier adjudicates. The controls here pin that the runner keeps that half while the refusal escapes. target=OnPrem because Database.AlterKey is OnPrem-only.
